description: List the rules of a BREX data module in readable form: for each rule, the target (XPath), whether it is forbidden / required / optional, the allowed values with their meanings, severity, and the schema context it applies to. Also returns the BREX header (DMC, parent BREX, counts). Use "kind" and "context" to narrow, "offset"/"limit" to page.

brex.description: Which BREX to use: a file path to a BREX data module (.xml), or a DMC (e.g. "KENBAIKI-A-00-00-00-00A-022A-D", "DMC-" prefix optional) searched in csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR / S1000D_SPEC_DIR. Omit to use the S1000D default BREX found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR.

context.description: Only rules that apply to this schema (file name such as "descript", "proced", "pm") plus the common rules. Omit for all contexts.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for BREX by DMC (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; S1000D_SPEC_DIR is always searched for the S1000D default BREX). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

offset.description: Index of the first rule to return (default 0).

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in objectPath, objectUse, rule id or value meanings.

name: explain_brex
